_notes: Paper only: simple_pmm on binance_paper_trade (conf_simple_pmm.yml). compose_paper.py refuses any connector that is not *_paper_trade.
hummingbot_bridge.py reads the container's trades DB and log from bots/compose/hummingbot/ (never conf/connectors).
Needs HUMMINGBOT_PASSWORD in bots/wrapper/.env (owner only). No exchange keys for paper.
The first start builds the image from bots/upstream/hummingbot (10-20 minutes once).
Stop by hand: from bots/compose, docker compose --env-file ../wrapper/.env down
